change_log: v13: [adaptive-regime-weights] Added 'regime_weights' top-level block (Pass 2c).
enabled: true  -- master switch; set false to bypass gate entirely.
trending.alignment_bonus: 1   -- added when EMA+ROC(gated)+CVD all align with direction.
trending.conflict_penalty: 1  -- deducted when all three conflict.
range_bound.alignment_bonus/conflict_penalty: 1/1 for VWAP dev+RSI(9)vs50+Donchian.
TRANSITIONAL: gate suppressed. Zero-net-score run: gate suppressed.
ROC active only when Abs(ROC) >= indicators.ROC.slope_sensitivity.
VWAP active only when VWAP not in warmup (VWAPSessionCandles >= VWAP.warmup_candles).
RegimeMaxScore bumped +1 for TRENDING (19→20) and RANGE_BOUND (18→19).
Verdict % thresholds auto-adjust via Math.Ceiling(regimeMax * pct).
v12: [session-volume-norms] Added top-level 'session_volume' block.
enabled: true  -- master switch; set false to bypass session scaling entirely.
sessions: 3 UTC bucket entries (ASIA 00-07, LONDON 08-12, NY 13-23).
Each bucket carries high_multiplier and mid_multiplier applied to
DynamicNorms.VolHighThreshold / VolMidThreshold after dynamic computation.
ASIA defaults 0.8/0.85 (lower liquidity), LONDON 1.0/1.0 (neutral),
NY 1.15/1.1 (elevated liquidity). Tune after 50+ runs per session.
v11: [oi-cvd-cross-confirm] Added 'oi_cvd_cross' block under 'indicators' with 3 keys:
enabled: true        -- master switch for Pass 2b gate in ScoringEngine_Calculate_Scoring
upgrade_bonus: 1     -- score added when OI full/partial and CVD direction confirm each other
conflict_penalty: 1  -- score deducted when OI full signal and CVD directly oppose
Set upgrade_bonus or conflict_penalty to 0 to disable that half without code change.
v10: [funding-momentum] Added 'funding' block under 'indicators' with 5 keys:
momentum_enabled: true  -- master switch for Step 3b / CalcFundingMomentum()
momentum_window: 3      -- samples back to compare against most recent rate
momentum_threshold: 0.0001 -- min abs delta (1 bp) to classify RISING/FALLING
momentum_amplify: 1     -- extra penalty when momentum confirms crowding
momentum_soften: 1      -- score restored when momentum signals de-crowding
v9: [fix] Funding thresholds recalibrated from current_funding scale to funding_8h scale.
funding_high_positive:  0.001  -> 0.0001  (0.01%/8h)
funding_low_positive:   0.0005 -> 0.00005 (0.005%/8h)
funding_high_negative: -0.001  -> -0.0001
funding_low_negative:  -0.0005 -> -0.00005
Conservative starting points for BTC-PERPETUAL. Review after 50+ runs.
v8: [Kelly] Added kelly block (account_size_usd, use_half_kelly, max_risk_fraction, contract_face_usd, est_prob_floor, est_prob_scale). CAL mode removed; EST mode only until backtesting module ships.

v7: [Step 5b] Added context_tag_structural_min (default 3) and context_tag_flow_max (default 1) to scoring block. Used by CalcVerdictContext() to classify FLOW_UNCONFIRMED / MOMENTUM_FADING / STRUCTURALLY_WEAK.
